mechanism: Naproxen may increase chlorpromazine levels via CYP450 inhibition and displacement from protein binding, while chlorpromazine may increase naproxen GI toxicity risk; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine side effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms) and naproxen GI adverse effects; consider alternative NSAID or use lowest effective naproxen dose with gastroprotection.
